name: Colosseum Inspired UI Overhaul
author: Community
description: Colosseum-inspired UI overhaul for Gen1Recomp. 2.2.0 is a cross-generation performance and code-cleanup release: Gen I Pokédex 3D information models now reuse hot provider bindings and resident actors, render their private model canvas at a bounded 60 Hz, avoid legacy donor-skin interception, cache expensive Dex/typography/options/provider work, and retain the shared CBE/Stadium/Battle Arts/custom presentation architecture. It preserves the universal Gen II battle-overlay compositor fix, shiny support, Egg UI, fixed HUD/menu metrics, Gen I naming flow, and all existing Gen I/II compatibility.
